Draft text (from the #inc-vtg-hartford incident room):

**Subject:** Hartford gate kiosks: incident summary (Aug 3)

Hi Mateo,

Here's a short summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident from August 3.

- **Outage:** On Aug 3 the gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.
- **Recovery:** Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03. Both lanes were confirmed working at 11:07 on Aug 3.
- **Status-page access:** Your admin login still gets "access denied" on the status page. That's tracked in ticket INC-4821, which has the screenshot. We're still working on it.

Scheduling via the dispatch office kept working throughout. Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Gideon

Please remove the sentence I wrongly included earlier about check-ins moving to paper; the incident room doesn't say that. Also, I don't have Mateo's email address, so please send it to me when Ruth approves and I'll create the draft.
